segments.description: B-roll clips showcasing a shopping cart with groceries and cooked meals as budget dinner teasers.
Host speaks to camera in her kitchen about rising grocery prices and introducing five $5 budget family dinners.
Host walks through Walmart selecting ingredients while discussing pricing, strategy, and meal planning on a budget.
Step-by-step cooking montage of preparing and plating the $5 budget dinner recipes.
Montage showing cooking process and finished dishes for chicken vegetable soup, chili cornbread casserole, sausage broccoli rice, and ham fried rice.
Host returns on camera in kitchen thanking viewers and asking them to subscribe for more budget meal videos.

hook.opening_visual: A shopping cart filled with budget grocery items moving through store aisle.
hook.opening_line: An issue that we are all faced with right now is that we keep hoping grocery prices are going to come down
hook.notes: Fast-paced visual montage with on-screen text establishing the $5 budget dinner concept.

cta_moments.text: Make sure you're subscribed down below the video so you don't miss the next one like this!
